text: Synthetic internal policy: when an employee leaves, the owner must revoke application access and retain a dated evidence record of closure. A supervisor periodically samples these records.
Synthetic AI governance policy: high-impact model decisions require recorded model version, evidence of evaluation, named reviewer and documented human approval before deployment.

Synthetic financial-control example: a missing reconciliation is a deficiency indicator. The auditor must evaluate further evidence and materiality rather than automatically conclude an adverse audit opinion.
Synthetic ESG assurance protocol: locate the applicable reporting framework version, assurance scope, evidence origin, and reporting period before concluding whether a disclosure is supported.
Synthetic audit reporting note: a critical audit matter communicates challenging auditor judgment; its presence alone is not proof of a material misstatement or fraud.
